l3_gate4_sigma.cluster_note: the 81 fixes are 13 windows x 5-7 fixes; a within-window-correlated sd UNDER-estimates the true per-fix scatter and the iid CI is too tight. The cluster bootstrap (resample whole windows) and ICC->N_eff give the honest CI.

a_axis_convention.note: surrogate diag order [lateral=gateX, vertical=gateY, depth=gateZ] == shadow rel_cross/rel_vert in the SAME gate.R_world_gate frame -> labels are consistent (NOT a swap).
a_axis_convention.cause: gate-4 is a high-crab gate (crab 36-54 deg) -> the yaw/crab-coupled CROSS(X) axis is inflated; this is real geometry, not a labelling bug.
a_axis_convention.verdict: AXIS contributes ~0 of the 0.28-vs-0.10 *vertical* gap (labels match). What it DOES explain is the opposite anisotropy: gate-4 moves the noise from vert->lateral via high crab.

b_pooling.note: the 0.28 is inflated by the noisier 10-20 m near-band (strong-perspective PnP) + cross-flight pooling. At the gate-4 operating range 20-24 m, two INDEPENDENT datasets agree the per-fix vertical scatter is ~0.10 (P3 0.097, L3 0.101), NOT 0.28.
b_pooling.verdict: POOLING (near-band + cross-flight) is the DOMINANT driver of the 0.28-vs-0.10 vertical gap: floor->subband alone is 26% of the inflation; the residual subband->gate4 (0.235->0.10) is range-matching + gate-specificity.

c_speed.surrogate_fit_set: simops-mastery (6 flights / 125 clean rows), Track-3 at-speed
c_speed.static_vs_moving_invariance: P3 22-24 m: static-hover vs moving-approach rel_vert differ by 0.007 m (FORM_RESOLUTION) -> at <=18 m/s the per-fix vertical sd is speed-flat (P3-low-speed 0.097 ~= L3-18m/s 0.10).
c_speed.at_speed_caveat: L3 is ~17-18 m/s (inc7). The BINDING gate-4 is ~30 m/s (doctrine) / older 37 m/s. Motion-blur sigma at 30-37 m/s is UNMEASURED -- a standing caveat, gated on the held inc8 envelope-relaxed policy. Do NOT claim the 0.10 holds at 30+ m/s.
c_speed.verdict: SPEED explains ~0 of the 0.28-vs-0.10 gap in the MEASURED 0-18 m/s range (sd is speed-flat there). It is the OPEN risk ABOVE 18 m/s, not a current contributor to the discrepancy.

d_boresight_wander.note: the surrogate vertical bias_band is NON-stationary (0.01->0.186->0.197 across range bands) = a constant epsilon_vert mixing with range -> per-band bias wander folds into the pooled FLOOR as scatter. In the gate-4 windows the between-window mean wander is small (std-of-means 0.039) and most variance is within-window.
d_boresight_wander.verdict: BORESIGHT-WANDER is a SECONDARY inflator of the surrogate floor (a few cm: bias_band swings ~0.19 across bands, whose mixing adds scatter when pooled). After the -0.25 m bake, the mean epsilon is removed; the residual *wander* (std-of-means ~0.04 at gate-4) is small and already inside the per-fix sd.

variance_ladder.interpretation: of the TOTAL vertical variance removed going 0.28->0.10, ~35% is the near-band pooling (10-20 m) and ~65% is range-matching to 20-24 m + gate-4 specificity. AXIS=0, SPEED=0 (in 0-18 m/s), WANDER=secondary (folded inside the floor).

decomposition_0p28_vs_0p10.headline: POOLING dominates: the surrogate 0.28 = pooled STD over 10-26 m (its own 20-26 sub-band is 0.235); at the gate-4 operating range 20-24 m two independent datasets give per-fix vertical sigma ~0.10. AXIS=0 (labels match; gate-4 just moves noise vert->lateral via high crab). SPEED=0 in 0-18 m/s (speed-flat) but UNMEASURED >18 m/s (standing caveat). WANDER=secondary (boresight bias_band mixing folds into the pooled floor).

recommendation.rationale: ENGINE uses ONE in-plane sigma for both axes -> the ISOTROPIC value must be the in-plane-radial-equivalent sqrt((lat^2+vert^2)/2)=0.153, NOT the clean 0.10 vertical (using 0.10 would UNDER-state the miss by ignoring the crab-coupled 0.19 lateral). CENTRAL=0.153; CONSERVATIVE=0.168 (upper cluster-bootstrap CI). The ANISOTROPIC pair [0.191 lat, 0.101 vert] is the honest shape for the engine-prep worker's extended two-sigma engine.
recommendation.honesty_flag: POST-BAKE the VERTICAL axis is clean (sigma_vert 0.10) but the LATERAL axis is 0.19 (crab-coupled at this high-crab gate). The in-plane miss is LATERAL-dominated, NOT vertical-dominated. The bake fixes the vertical BIAS (-0.25 m mean), not the lateral SCATTER. Margin closure now rides on the lateral 0.19 + fix-rate, not the vertical.
recommendation.vs_old_modeled: 0.265 (production GATE_REL_INPLANE_SIGMA / SIGMA_MODELED) is CONSERVATIVE vs both the iso-central 0.153 and the iso-conservative 0.168 -> the modeled constant already bounds the L3 gate-4 in-plane scatter.
recommendation.at_speed_caveat: L3 is ~17-18 m/s (inc7). The BINDING gate-4 is ~30 m/s (doctrine) / older 37 m/s. Motion-blur sigma at 30-37 m/s is UNMEASURED -- a standing caveat, gated on the held inc8 envelope-relaxed policy. Do NOT claim the 0.10 holds at 30+ m/s.

margin_sanity_probe._caveat: SANITY probe only (n_mc=400); the AUTHORITATIVE gate-4 margin re-run is the engine-prep worker job (apply bake + this sigma). COLD case-C, bias_mode=inplane, latency 15 ms.
margin_sanity_probe.finding: recal iso 0.153 ~HALVES p90/p99 vs modeled 0.265 (real relief), but the COLD design point still does NOT clear r=0.30 at fr<=0.25 -- only at fr>=0.50. CONFIRMS fix-rate is the binding lever, NOT sigma. r=0.38 cold never clears here. Closure rides on TERMINAL fix-rate (camera pointing, P3-validated 67-77%), consistent with the standing CANNOT-SETTLE-at-measured-fix-rate verdict.
